mirrored_views.left: mirrored from right at render, as the source draws it

provenance: AUTHORED for beret_02, cell by cell in Pixelsmith. Visual rules taken from the hat_8 plaid reference: 1-logical-pixel lines, 1px crossings, open grid, darker than the local colour. Cells are placed for this shape, not copied from hat_8 (its exact mask does not fit beret_02 and V2 refuses it). Lines are kept off the outline, off underside-contact cells and off the dark crown mark; the right-view vertical sits at x6 because at x5 it doubled the source's own #a5a5a5 edge column. factor 0.72 is the darkest line/flank ratio drawn in hat_8 (measured range 0.721-0.943): at the median 0.823 the line tone lands on beret_02's own #d6d6d6 dither step and merges into 2px strokes.
